title: Vector-bundle purity before smooth orientation
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_F$ and uniformizer $\varpi_F$, and $n\geq1$, and put $A=A_{F,n}=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $\pi:E\to S$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $d\geq0$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. For every $S$-scheme $T$, the finite-level pro-etale Tate sheaf $A_T^{\mathrm{pro}}(1)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] has a canonical ordinary-etale descent $A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(1)$ along $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Explicitly, for any $r\geq1$ with $\ell^r A=0$ it is $\mu_{\ell^r,T}^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^r}A_T$ [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], canonically independent of $r$, with
$$\nu_T^*A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(1)\cong A_T^{\mathrm{pro}}(1).$$
Use its tensor powers to interpret $A_T(d)$ and $K(d)=K\otimes_A^LA_T(d)$ on the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-kun-derived-tensor]. Use the vector-bundle integration $t_\pi$ of [def-amb-vector-integration], with these coefficient identifications: it is the unique map restricting on each trivializing open to the specified affine-space trace of [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace], and its bounded coefficient object and map agree with the pro-etale realization under the canonical proper/open site comparisons. For every $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the adjoint of
$$
R\pi_!(\pi^*K(d)[2d])
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}_{\pi,K}^{-1}}K\otimes_A^LR\pi_!A_E(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{1\otimes t_\pi}K
$$
under the ordinary compact-support adjunction $R\pi_!\dashv\pi^\times$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] is an isomorphism
$$\gamma_{\pi,K}:\pi^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi^\times K.$$
Here $\pi^*$ is exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and $\mathrm{PF}_{\pi,K}$ is the canonical tensor projection map obtained from open extension by zero and the proper projection map [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection] on a compactification. No boundedness, constructibility, or finite Tor-amplitude condition is imposed on $K$.

proof.text: Transport invertibility of ell along every S-scheme structure map and apply finite Tate descent, retaining its normalized exponent transitions and uniqueness. In the coefficient integer ring ell belongs to the maximal ideal by the spectral norm; raising to n+1 puts it in the uniformizer ideal power, so its quotient and ULift are zero.

The defining unique gluing theorem gives exactly the normalization of vectorBundleIntegration. The finite Tate line is flat by the torsion twist line theorem. Its shifted single complex has finite Tor amplitude. Induct on the ordered tensor power to prove boundedness, then use exact inverse image. The bounded-below full subcategory supplies its representative.

For every representative a, its image under comparison and compact support is an isomorphism alpha. The unique pro-etale realization is alpha inverse followed by the specified site comparison and comparison of the trace. The two identities and uniqueness follow by cancellation of alpha.

Use the finite-coefficient unbounded compact-support projection theorem to invert the actual signed coefficient-first projection map. Take p to be the symmetric asIso of that map. Apply the proved [lem-amb-vector-integration-mate] to its normalized integration adjunct. The expanded compactification, projection and ambient adjunction definitions coincide, giving precisely the required last clause.

lean.note: The theorem includes normalized finite Tate descent on every S-scheme, independence of the annihilating positive ell-power, and uniqueness. The positive quotient level is n+1. The annihilator ell^(n+1)=0 is asserted as a conclusion, never imposed as a hypothesis. VectorBundlePurityAtModulus expands to the actual trace normalization, bounded coefficient and its uniquely specified proper/open pro-etale realization, and the actual integration adjunct for every unbounded K. The projection inverse is characterized by its inverse being the canonical compactified tensor projection map with the signed symmetries. No compactification, twist transport, trace, boundedness or Tor condition is an extra hypothesis.
